items.a: ServiceNow testing checks that workflows, forms, portals and integrations on a ServiceNow instance work after configuration changes, patches and family releases.
ATF is ServiceNow's built-in Automated Test Framework for testing inside an instance. TestMu AI complements it with end-to-end tests that also cover external systems and browsers.

items.q: How do you test a ServiceNow upgrade?
items.a: Run your regression tests against the upgraded instance before go-live. TestMu AI tests heal UI changes and fail on real behaviour changes.
Yes. Tests are written in plain English.

items.q: How does TestMu AI connect to ServiceNow?
items.a: TestMu AI is independent of ServiceNow. It tests your instance through the UI and APIs you already use.
